pages.title: The work
pages.text:
**Assignment list:** chapter **Strand: Claw**.

Silent Gear blueprints, iron on your back, a bow, a portal frame. Leave the pad on purpose.

Finish the **Claw Knot** and seat Claw. Edge opens the braid: Pattern, Colony, and Hum are all yours to choose from. You need any **two** before Bind.

pages.title: Edge
pages.text: The Edge-walkers kept footholds past the last fence post. Boots first. Then the bridge. Then the courage.
